hero.alt: A radiant light emerging from deep baroque darkness

glossary.name: Actuality
glossary.definition: A thing being fully at work as the kind of thing it is, rather than existing only as an unrealized capacity.

glossary.name: Convertibility
glossary.definition: The claim that being and goodness name one reality under two descriptions: what is, and what attracts or fulfills.

glossary.name: The Euthyphro dilemma
glossary.definition: The question whether something is good because God commands it, or God commands it because it is independently good.

glossary.name: Privation
glossary.definition: A lack of a good that a thing ought to possess, rather than a positive substance called evil.

glossary.name: Modal collapse
glossary.definition: The worry that if God's nature necessitates every divine act, no genuinely contingent world remains possible.

glossary.name: Thomas Aquinas
glossary.definition: The thirteenth-century philosopher and theologian whose account of being, actuality, goodness, and participation anchors this volume.

glossary.name: Augustine
glossary.definition: The North African thinker whose Confessions uses desire, judgment, and restless longing as a path toward God.

glossary.name: David Hume
glossary.definition: The Scottish empiricist whose challenges to causation, reason, and theism appear throughout the skeptical pressure-test.

glossary.name: Alvin Plantinga
glossary.definition: An analytic philosopher of religion whose free-will defense and arguments about naturalism inform the later chapters.

visuals.title: Potentiality becoming actuality
visuals.label: METAPHYSICS
visuals.caption: The oak is in the acorn as a real possibility, not yet as a fact.
visuals.alt: A luminous acorn rests on dark soil while the faint shadow of a full oak rises behind it.

visuals.title: The ontological scale
visuals.label: DIAGRAM
visuals.caption: A visual reminder that evil is not a rival substance standing opposite being.

visuals.title: The wound in the good
visuals.label: PRIVATION
visuals.caption: Evil appears here not as a competing substance, but as a luminous order interrupted by absence.
visuals.alt: A glowing ivory sphere stands on a stone pedestal in a dark room, its clean crescent-shaped absence surrounded by floating damaged leaves.

visuals.title: The corridor of mirrors
visuals.label: COSMOLOGY
visuals.caption: Borrowed light needs a lamp, however long the corridor.
visuals.alt: A corridor of mirrors passes reflected light from one surface to the next while a hidden lamp glows beyond the frame.

visuals.title: Essence and existence
visuals.label: ONTOLOGY
visuals.caption: In finite things, what a thing is and that it is are not identical.

visuals.title: The bridge between what and that
visuals.label: ESSENCE / EXISTENCE
visuals.caption: The bridge joins a thing's intelligible form to the fact that it is, without making the two identical.
visuals.alt: A narrow stone bridge crosses a dark chasm from a small glowing geometric object toward a distant amber light on the horizon.

visuals.title: The terminus
visuals.label: THEOLOGY
visuals.caption: Not the biggest item in the inventory, but the reason there is an inventory at all.
visuals.alt: A stone staircase rises through a dark interior toward a small opening filled with warm light.

visuals.title: The essentially ordered series
visuals.label: ARGUMENT MAP
visuals.caption: Ten thousand cars that cannot move themselves are exactly as motionless as one.

visuals.title: The names of the source
visuals.label: ANALOGY
visuals.caption: Many true names, none synonymous: creatures are the spectrum, God is the light.

visuals.title: Rowe's fawn
visuals.label: SKEPTICAL PRESSURE
visuals.caption: The objection with real blood in it. No one has the receipt.
visuals.alt: A small fawn rests in a shadowed forest clearing beneath a distant, indifferent sky.

visuals.title: Seven lines, one cable
visuals.label: SYNTHESIS
visuals.caption: Partial confirmations multiply when the case is cumulative rather than solitary.
visuals.alt: Many separate golden threads twist together into a single cable that disappears into a field of light.

visuals.title: An answer in person
visuals.label: THEOLOGY
visuals.caption: Solidarity, where explanation was demanded.
visuals.alt: A weathered crucifix stands in deep shadow while warm light gathers around the figure.

visuals.title: The cast of the argument
visuals.label: 2,400 YEARS
visuals.caption: A compressed history of the questions this essay brings into one case.

visuals.title: Two maps of the territory
visuals.label: METHOD
visuals.caption: You cannot step outside all maps; you can see which one keeps working.
